# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)

| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | wrong-pivot-api | sales-pivot-analysis (5 trials, 0.00) | Skill example uses non-existent classes: `PivotTable` (→ `TableDefinition`), `CacheFields` (not importable), `PivotField(x=N)` (→ `RowColField(x=N)`). Agents follow the example, hit ImportError/AttributeError, fall back to pandas static data. | CAPABILITY-GAP | Fix class names + imports in xlsx/SKILL.md pivot example |
| 2 | formula-vs-numbers | xlsx-recover-data (5 trials, 0.00) | Skill says "write formula strings"; verifier checks exact numeric values; recalc.py needs LibreOffice (not installed). t0: wrote formulas, 0/8 tests. t1: wrote numbers, 7/8 passed. The guidance was wrong for this task type. | KNOWLEDGE | Rewrite "Recovering missing values" section: compute numbers, not formulas |
| 3 | ignores-template-2 | reserves-at-risk-calc (5 trials, 0.00) | t0 STILL created `Workbook()` with fake US/Germany/etc. despite Step 0 guidance from iter 1. Step 0 prose insufficient. t1 found template but had wrong exposure formula AND test_formulas_present requires formula strings (not Python numbers). | BEHAVIORAL + KNOWLEDGE | Strengthen Step 0 to CRITICAL; add financial-model formula-cells rule |
| 4 | drops-incomplete-games | financial-modeling-qa (5 trials, 0.00) | Both t0/t1 skipped Game 8 (1 of 2 turns missing) from the analysis. Correct approach: include Game 8, score it on its single available turn. t0: answered 25, t1: answered 24; correct answer is 23. | KNOWLEDGE | Add "Incomplete records" rule in xlsx common pitfalls |
| 5 | multipage-header-drop | pdf-excel-diff (2 trials, 0.20) | Both t0/t1 applied `table[1:]` on every page, dropping first data row from pages 2–229. Lost ~228 records → missed 2 modified employees → got 18 modified instead of 20. | BEHAVIORAL | Fix pdf/SKILL.md Advanced Table Extraction example |
| 6 | if-key-mismatch | offer-letter-generator (1 failing trial, 0.80) | t4 extracted condition_key=«redacted» from `{{IF_RELOCATION}}`, did `data.get('RELOCATION', '') = ''`, got should_include=False, removed relocation content. Data had `RELOCATION_PACKAGE: "Yes"`. Skill didn't show prefix-matching lookup. | KNOWLEDGE | Add `get_condition_value()` with prefix matching to docx/SKILL.md |
| 7 | sentinel-po-literal | invoice-fraud-detection (t0, 0.20 overall) | t0: copied `"PO-INVALID"` from PDF literally instead of mapping to `null`. Test expected `None` for invalid/missing PO numbers. Skill had no guidance on sentinel values. | KNOWLEDGE | Add sentinel value normalization to pdf/SKILL.md |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)

| cluster | edit class | file | what & why it generalizes | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| wrong-pivot-api | CAPABILITY-GAP | xlsx/SKILL.md | Fixed import: `TableDefinition` (not `PivotTable`), `RowColField` (not `PivotField`), removed `CacheFields` wrapper (use list directly). CRITICAL/IMPORTANT comments call out each wrong name. | BOUNDED — only agents creating pivot tables; exceltable-in-ppt doesn't create pivot tables |
| formula-vs-numbers | KNOWLEDGE | xlsx/SKILL.md | Changed LibreOffice note from "assume installed" to "may not be installed"; rewrote "Recovering missing values" to compute numbers not formulas; added range-accuracy note ("count actual data rows"). | BOUNDED — recovery guidance only for ??? placeholder tasks; passing tasks use formula-writing which is unchanged |
| ignores-template-2 | BEHAVIORAL | xlsx/SKILL.md | Strengthened Step 0 to CRITICAL, "BEFORE writing any code", "NEVER call Workbook()" with explicit explanation that template contains real country names/data. | BOUNDED — only affects workbook creation decision; exceltable-in-ppt uses pptx skill |
| drops-incomplete-games | KNOWLEDGE | xlsx/SKILL.md | Added "Incomplete records" pitfall: do NOT skip records with missing/null entries, score using available data. | BOUNDED — only affects paired-record analysis; exceltable-in-ppt doesn't do game analysis |
| financial-model-formulas | KNOWLEDGE | xlsx/SKILL.md | Added "Financial model formula cells" pitfall: if test checks `test_formulas_present`, ALL computation cells need formula strings. | BOUNDED — only for financial model tasks; exceltable-in-ppt doesn't have test_formulas_present |
| multipage-header-drop | BEHAVIORAL | pdf/SKILL.md | Rewrote Advanced Table Extraction to track header from first page only; subsequent pages use all rows. Added CRITICAL warning about the bug pattern. | BOUNDED — only affects multi-page PDF table extraction; no passing task reads multi-page PDFs |
| sentinel-po-literal | KNOWLEDGE | pdf/SKILL.md | Added "Field Value Normalization" section with SENTINEL_VALUES set and `normalize_field()` helper; "PO-INVALID" is first in the list. | BOUNDED — only affects JSON output from PDF extraction; no passing task extracts PDF fields to JSON |
| if-key-mismatch | KNOWLEDGE | docx/SKILL.md | Added `get_condition_value()` with prefix matching: `RELOCATION` → searches for `RELOCATION_PACKAGE` etc. Added CRITICAL note with worked example. | BOUNDED — only for conditional docx templates; exceltable-in-ppt doesn't use docx conditionals |

## Verify-the-fix (one line per change)

- **pivot API**: trace shows agents got `ImportError: 'PivotTable' not in openpyxl.pivot.table` then `ImportError: CacheFields` then `TypeError: PivotField got x kwarg`. All three are fixed by the changed imports/class names. Passing task (exceltable-in-ppt) doesn't call pivot table code → guard does NOT fire.

- **recovery numbers**: t0 wrote `'=SUM(B5:J5)'`, test got string not 19285 → 0/8. t1 wrote numbers, 7/8 passed. New guidance says "compute numerically"; passing task exceltable-in-ppt has no recovery section → unaffected.

- **Step 0**: t0 created new `Workbook()` producing US/Germany/etc. countries; template had Armenia/Belarus/Georgia etc. Stronger Step 0 says CRITICAL + "NEVER call Workbook() when a file already exists". exceltable-in-ppt is a pptx task, doesn't check /root/ for xlsx templates → unaffected.

- **incomplete records**: t0/t1 both skipped Game 8 → 25/24 instead of 23. New pitfall says "score incomplete games on available turns". exceltable-in-ppt does table-in-pptx, not game analysis → unaffected.

- **financial model formulas**: t1 reserves-at-risk wrote Python numbers for all cells → test_formulas_present fails. New pitfall says "computation cells must be formula strings". exceltable-in-ppt doesn't have test_formulas_present → unaffected.

- **multi-page header**: t0/t1 both used `table[1:]` on every page (229 pages) → lost 228 records → missed EMP05566, EMP07590 → 18 modified not 20. New example uses `rows = table` for pages 2+. No passing task uses this code path → unaffected.

- **sentinel values**: t0 exact error: `PO Number mismatch for page 4: Expected 'None', Got 'PO-INVALID'`. New SENTINEL_VALUES set includes "PO-INVALID" → maps to null. No passing task extracts PDF invoice fields → unaffected.

- **IF key prefix match**: t4 exact path: `condition_key=«redacted» `data.get('RELOCATION','')=''`, `should_include=False`, content removed. New `get_condition_value()` tries prefix match → finds `RELOCATION_PACKAGE: 'Yes'` → `should_include=True`. t0/t3 passed (different code path used by those agents). exceltable-in-ppt doesn't process docx conditionals → unaffected.

## Process & features used
- Parallel subagent reads: 6 trajectory-reading agents launched simultaneously (xlsx-recover-data, sales-pivot-analysis, financial-modeling-qa, reserves-at-risk-calc, offer-letter+invoice-fraud, pdf-excel-diff). Also read offer-letter t4 specifically.
- All 3 skill files edited: xlsx/SKILL.md (5 edits), pdf/SKILL.md (2 edits), docx/SKILL.md (1 edit)
- Prior iterations read: cand_0001 PROCESS.md + diff.patch, LEDGER.md, JOURNAL.md, RUNMAP.md

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The CacheDefinition + TableDefinition working example in xlsx pivot section (corrected this iter)
- The recalc.py integration in xlsx Common Workflow step 5 (needed for formula-writing tasks)
- The pptx OOXML editing workflow with step 3b (recalc embedded xlsx before repacking) — do NOT undo
- The existing "Use Formulas, Not Hardcoded Values" section (general financial models still need formulas)

## Deliberately skipped
- **xlsx-recover-data range error in t1**: t1 computed wrong average (averaged 6 years instead of 5). Added "count actual data rows" guidance but this is a soft hint. Full fix would require domain-specific range detection.
- **reserves-at-risk-calc URL/download failure**: t1 couldn't fetch IMF data (404). Infrastructure issue; unfixable from skill side.
- **invoice-fraud-detection t1**: Complete non-completion (agent stalled after skill invocation). Likely context/infrastructure issue; no skill fix available.
